name: Mui Borok
instructions: 1. Lightly roast or boil the fermented fish (Berma) in a small amount of water to soften it.
2. In a mortar and pestle, crush the garlic, ginger, and green chilies until they form a coarse paste.
3. Add the softened fermented fish to the paste and pound it together until well integrated.
4. Add finely chopped onions and salt, mixing thoroughly while maintaining a coarse texture.
5. Adjust consistency with a little warm water if desired and serve as a side dish with steamed rice.
description: Mui Borok is a foundational dish of the Tripuri people. The key ingredient, Berma, is a sun-dried and fermented fish paste that provides a distinct, umami-rich flavor profile essential to traditional indigenous Tripuri cuisine.
